# Goose

Version: 1.57.0, source cfb67d72f6129ba3c9f68d4c225d8dfcaba18a87. Inspected on Windows x64, 2026-11-02.

Hand-written from Goose's own configuration code (`config/extensions.rs`, `agents/large_response_handler.rs`): the official portable program, run with an isolated GOOSE_PATH_ROOT, made no `config.yaml` of its own. Its response limit is its default; extensions are entries of `extensions`.

Upstream: https://goose-docs.ai/docs/guides/config-files/
